summary: Costamare Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing a proxy statement and notice for its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, scheduled for October 6, 2026, to be held virtually. The meeting agenda includes electing one Class I director, ratifying Ernst Young (Hellas) as independent auditors, and transacting other business. The board unanimously recommends voting for the director election and auditor ratification. This is a routine annual meeting notice with no special-situation components such as mergers, tenders, or management changes. The filing solely concerns standard governance items and proxy solicitation, with no deal terms or strategic actions disclosed.
